name: Hag’Salar
description: Amidst the dunes and stone remnants lies the ruins of the Summer Elves Kingdom of Hag’Salar, once a splendid realm remembered for its cultural diversity and trading. Though the civilization has crumbled, its spirit endures, as the ruins are a meeting point for cultural exchange. The Alchemist Oasis, located within Hag’Salar, has become a sacred site for all barbarian communities of the south. Combat is strictly forbidden here, fostering peace and becoming a hub of commerce among the tribes. Every year during the summer solstice, a ten-day bazaar takes place in Hag’Salar. Tribes, merchants, and caravans from different lands assemble here, setting up their tents and stalls and transforming the desert into a vast marketplace. Most Summer elves visit this bazaar at least once every five years to reconnect with each other and exchange goods, knowledge, and stories from their voyages across the continent. During these events, tribes forge alliances and buy products from across Tanares. The absence of external laws grants a unique freedom, permitting the trade of goods otherwise restricted in different regions. Recently, the Kepesh have also turned their attention to this celebration. They propagate the faith of Ba-Ka and recruit from among the barbarians and the marginalized, integrating them into Kepesh society. Yet, the Kepesh approach cautiously, knowing well the potential threat of the barbarians to their expansionist aims. Another allure of this land is the treasures of the ancient Summer elves, which can be found in its lost ruins. The Kepesh often organize expeditions into the subterranean depths, bestowing lesser artifacts and gold to the barbarians to ensure cooperation. Some adventurers and explorers often travel here in search of treasures. Still, they must contend with the Kepesh, who want to keep the prizes for their Pharaoh, and the barbarians, who dislike intruders in their territories.
